entities.name: Pitre
entities.description: Thatcher and would-be vampire slayer from Hanweir on Innistrad.

entities.name: Lorelei
entities.description: Mayor's daughter whom Pitre loved; she beheaded him.

entities.name: Jurgen Garensun
entities.description: Mayor of Hanweir who saw Pitre as unworthy.

entities.name: Thatu Reiniger
entities.description: Powerful vampire lord who fatally wounded Pitre.

entities.name: Raben Amsel
entities.description: Came seeking the cursed blade and burned Pitre's corpse.

entities.name: Erdwal
entities.description: Place Pitre went to hunt a vampire.

events.summary: Pitre kills a young vampire and is mistakenly hailed a hero, then leaves Hanweir for Erdwal to hunt a real vampire.
events.quote: Pitre left Hanweir for Erdwal to hunt a real vampire

events.summary: Pitre is fatally wounded by Thatu Reiniger and returns to Hanweir to die.
events.quote: Pitre was fatally wounded by Thatu

events.summary: Lorelei beheads Pitre to prevent his turning into a vampire.
Raben Amsel has Pitre's corpse exhumed and ends the curse by burning it.
events.quote: Amsel ended the curse on Pitre's corpse by burning it.

relations.quote: Pitre was fatally wounded by Thatu
the daughter of the mayor, Jurgen Garensun
